lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gills, exhibiting a semi-regular staggered spatial arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, effectively centering the high-intensity blobs within a grid-like structural network.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal carinae are visible on the lateral surface, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient running horizontally from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A bright white patch, potentially a scar or parasitic lesion, is visible near the ventral-posterior margin of the final gill slit. A small irregular notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Two remoras (Echeneidae) are attached: one located on the ventral posterior edge of the right pectoral fin and another on the ventral surface of the caudal peduncle. The right pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller spots relative to the lateral flank.
